findings.problem: Talk targets retain literal double quotes in installed 10.0.1-beta.1, preventing exact match to unquoted NPC names.
findings.correction: Remove surrounding quotes only from Talk target lines; preserve spaces. Fix gen-collection-log.py as source of generated quests before regeneration.

findings.problem: Five intended bonuses use sub-1 direct multipliers, reducing damage/regeneration/XP.
findings.evidence: Buffer_Main_Server assigns parsed float directly; BufferMain.ModifyAttack passes value to ApplyModifier; health/stamina/skill methods multiply by value. DamageReduction separately applies 1 - value and is correct.
